;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**The [[Taliban]] announce a three-day [[Eid al-Fitr|Eid]] ceasefire with the [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] authorities, according to [[Pajhwok Afghan News]]. On Thursday, [[President of Afghanistan|President]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] announced a ceasefire with the Taliban from June 12–19. [http://tass.com/world/1008858 (TASS)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-ceasefire/afghan-taliban-announce-surprise-three-day-eid-ceasefire-idUSKCN1J5050 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Twelve people are killed and 13 injured in two separate accidents in [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-06/10/c_137244209.htm (Xinhua)]

;International relations
*[[Shanghai Cooperation Organization]]
**The 18th Council of Heads of State meets in [[Qingdao]], [[China]]. [https://nation.com.pk/09-Jun-2018/pakistan-aims-to-achieve-big-from-sco (''The Nation'')]
*[[44th G7 summit]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] calls for "fair and reciprocal" trades between the [[United States]] and other countries, claiming that the United States is a "piggy bank that everyone keeps robbing". [https://www.voanews.com/a/trump-g7-briefing/4431695.html (VOA)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-44423072 (BBC)]
**Donald Trump again calls for [[Russia]] to be reinstated into the group. Russia was suspended after the [[Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation|annexation of Crimea in 2014]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/09/politics/trump-russia-g8-press-conference/index.html (CNN)]
**Trump retracts his endorsement of the summit's final communiqué. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/justin-trudeau-trump-trade-fight-g7-today-2018-06-09/ (CBS News)]

;Politics and elections
*Over 100,000 people participate in a large protest in [[Bucharest]], [[Romania]], against apparent judicial abuses and "illegitimate interference" of the secret services in the political and judicial systems. The protest was organised by the governing [[Social Democratic Party (Romania)|Social Democratic Party]] and supported by other political parties. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/romania-pro-govt-rally-protests-anti-corruption-abuses/2018/06/09/325eafb0-6c04-11e8-a335-c4503d041eaf_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] 

;Sports
*[[2018 Belmont Stakes]]
**[[Justify (horse)|Justify]] wins the  [[Belmont Stakes]] and becomes the second horse in four years to win the U.S. [[Triple Crown of Thoroughbred Racing (United States)|Triple Crown of Thoroughbred Racing]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/06/09/sports/belmont-stakes-justify.html (''The New York Times'')]
